programs.name: UNIMAS - Bachelor in Computer Science (Computational Science) with Honours
programs.description: Computational Science is the field of study concerned with constructing mathematical models and its numerical solution techniques, as well as using computers to analyse and solve scientific, social, and engineering problems.
programs.curriculum:
The Bachelor in Computer Science (Computational Science) focuses on mathematical modeling, scientific computing, and problem-solving using computational methods. Core areas include:
- Programming & Software Development: Java, OOP, Web Development, Databases, Algorithms
- Mathematics & Statistics: Discrete Math, Differential Equations, Probability, Modeling & Simulation
- Systems & Infrastructure: Operating Systems, Computer Architecture, Networking, Parallel Computing
- AI & Advanced Topics: Artificial Intelligence, Computational Science Lab, Computer Security
- Professional Skills: Project Management, Technopreneurship, Ethics, Industrial Training
- Capstone: Final Year Projects with research and development focus

programs.name: UNIMAS - Bachelor in Computer Science (Data Engineering)
programs.description: This program trains students to design and implement computer-based systems that support business objectives and automate processes. Focusing on system development, data management, and decision-making, students gain skills in project management, organizational theory, and technology application, preparing them to manage complex systems and create innovative solutions in various industries.
programs.curriculum:
The Bachelor in Computer Science (Data Engineering) focuses on systems development, data management, and information technologies. Core areas include:
- Programming & Software Development: Java, OOP, Web Development, Databases, Algorithms
- Mathematics & Statistics: Discrete Math, Probability, Statistics, Data Analytics
- Systems & Infrastructure: Operating Systems, Computer Architecture, Distributed Systems, Networking
- AI & Machine Learning: Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Mining, Natural Language Processing
- Information Systems & Process Development: Information Systems in Organisations, System Development Tools
- Professional Skills: Project Management, Technopreneurship, Ethics, Industrial Training
- Capstone: Final Year Projects with practical and research focus

programs.name: Bachelor in Computer Science (Multimedia Computing) with Honours
programs.description: The program focuses on software systems for synchronizing multimedia types (video, audio, image). It covers multimedia system implementation, computer graphics, and UI/UX design, providing students with broad knowledge of multimedia technologies. Students will develop practical skills in programming, game and mobile app development, as well as artificial intelligence.
programs.curriculum:
The program emphasizes multimedia systems, programming, and user experience. Core areas include:
- Programming & Software Development: Java, OOP, Web Development, Mobile App Development, Game Design
- Mathematics & Statistics: Discrete Math, Probability, Statistics
- Computer Systems & Infrastructure: Operating Systems, Computer Architecture, Distributed Systems
- Multimedia & Graphics: Computer Graphics, UI/UX Design, Data Visualization
- AI & Advanced Topics: Artificial Intelligence, Data Analytics
- Professional Skills: Project Management, Technopreneurship, Ethics, Industrial Training
- Capstone: Final Year Projects with practical and research focus

programs.name: Bachelor of Software Engineering with Honours
programs.description: The program focuses on applying scientific and engineering principles to design, develop, and maintain software systems. Students will learn software engineering fundamentals, methodologies, tools, and quality assessment techniques. Graduates will be prepared with technical and soft skills, capable of developing high-quality, maintainable software, and pursuing careers in software development and management.
programs.curriculum:
The program emphasizes software engineering, development, and project management. Core areas include:
- Programming & Software Development: Java, OOP, Web Development, Software Lab
- Mathematics & Theoretical Foundations: Discrete Math, Automata Theory, Algorithms
- Systems & Infrastructure: Operating Systems, Computer Architecture, Networking
- Software Engineering Practices: System Analysis, Object-Oriented Engineering, Software Testing, Metrics, Configuration
- Professional Skills: Project Management, Technopreneurship, Ethics, Industrial Training
- Capstone: Final Year Projects with practical and research focus

programs.name: Bachelor in Computer Science (Network Computing) with Honours
programs.description: The program focuses on core areas of network computing, including high-speed networks, wireless systems, IoT, and blockchain. Students will gain skills in network infrastructure design, cybersecurity, and performance simulation. The program prepares graduates with both technical and soft skills for industry challenges. It takes 4 years to complete with 130 credit hours.
programs.curriculum:
The program covers network computing, security, and system development. Core areas include:
- Programming & Software Development: Java, OOP, Web Development, System Programming
- Mathematics & Theoretical Foundations: Discrete Math, Algorithms, Probability
- Systems & Infrastructure: Operating Systems, Computer Architecture, Networking, Wireless Systems, IoT, Embedded Systems
- Security & Performance: Cybersecurity, Network Simulation, Security Engineering
- Professional Skills: Project Management, Technopreneurship, Ethics, Industrial Training
- Capstone: Final Year Projects with practical and research focus
